raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Purpose

Fix embedding / encoder-only serving when a global `--kv-cache-dtype` is set (e.g. `bfloat16`).

`EncoderOnlyAttention` does not allocate a KV cache (`get_kv_cache_spec` returns `None`), but it still passed `cache_config.cache_dtype` into `get_attn_backend()`. CUDA backends then filter on that unused dtype and can raise:

```
ValueError: No valid attention backend found for cuda
```

instead of serving the embedding model (or failing with a clear config error).

This PR selects the encoder-only backend with `kv_cache_dtype="auto"`. `cache_config` is still forwarded to `Attention` for anything that actually needs it.

Fixes #55046

## Why this is not a duplicate

- Open PRs mentioning #55046: none.
- [#55150](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/55150) rejects *quantized* KV cache for encoder-only models during `VllmConfig` validation. This change is backend *selection* for encoder-only layers when a global (including non-quantized) `cache_dtype` is set. It does not add or move quantized-KV validation.
- [#55159](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/55159) / [#55160](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/55160) are about prefix caching on encoder models, not backend selection.

## Test Plan

```bash
.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/kernels/attention/test_attention_selector.py::test_encoder_only_attention_ignores_kv_cache_dtype tests/kernels/attention/test_attention_selector.py::test_encoder_only_backend_selected_with_global_cache_dtype -v
```

## Test Result

```
tests/kernels/attention/test_attention_selector.py::test_encoder_only_attention_ignores_kv_cache_dtype PASSED
tests/kernels/attention/test_attention_selector.py::test_encoder_only_backend_selected_with_global_cache_dtype PASSED
2 passed
```

No model-quality eval is required: this only changes which attention backend is *eligible* for encoder-only layers that never store KV. Outputs of valid decoder KV-cache configs are unchanged.

## AI assistance

This PR was developed with AI assistance. I reviewed every changed line and ran the tests reported above.

Checked the CodeRabbit linked-issue warning against #55046.

The repro is `Qwen3-Embedding` with `--kv-cache-dtype bfloat16 --mamba-cache-dtype float16 --mamba-ssm-cache-dtype float32`. Mamba cache-dtype validation belongs with models that allocate those caches, not with encoder-only backend selection.

files.patch:
@@ -11,6 +11,7 @@
 from vllm.config import (
     AttentionConfig,
     CacheConfig,
+    DeviceConfig,
     ParallelConfig,
     VllmConfig,
     set_current_vllm_config,
@@ -748,6 +749,64 @@ def test_fa4_hd256_mm_prefix_deselects_flash_attn():
         )
 
 
+@pytest.mark.skip_global_cleanup
+def test_encoder_only_attention_ignores_kv_cache_dtype():
+    """Encoder-only attention has no KV cache, so a global cache_dtype must
+    not be used for backend selection. Regression for #55046."""
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.attention import encoder_only_attention as eoa
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.attention.encoder_only_attention import (
+        EncoderOnlyAttention,
+    )
+
+    captured: dict[str, object] = {}
+    fake_backend = MagicMock()
+
+    def fake_get_attn_backend(head_size, dtype, kv_cache_dtype, **kwargs):
+        captured["kv_cache_dtype"] = kv_cache_dtype
+        captured["attn_type"] = kwargs.get("attn_type")
+        return fake_backend
+
+    cache_config = CacheConfig(cache_dtype="bfloat16")
+    with (
+        patch.object(eoa, "get_attn_backend", side_effect=fake_get_attn_backend),
+        patch.object(
+            eoa, "create_encoder_only_attention_backend", return_value=fake_backend
+        ),
+        patch.object(eoa.Attention, "__init__", return_value=None),
+    ):
+        EncoderOnlyAttention(
+            num_heads=8,
+            head_size=128,
+            scale=0.125,
+            cache_config=cache_config,
+        )
+
+    assert captured["kv_cache_dtype"] == "auto"
+    assert captured["attn_type"] == AttentionType.ENCODER_ONLY
+
+
+@pytest.mark.skip_global_cleanup
+def test_encoder_only_backend_selected_with_global_cache_dtype():
+    """A global --kv-cache-dtype bfloat16 must still yield an encoder-only
+    backend, because encoder-only layers select with kv_cache_dtype='auto'."""
+    vllm_config = VllmConfig(
+        cache_config=CacheConfig(cache_dtype="bfloat16"),
+        device_config=DeviceConfig(device="cpu"),
+    )
+    with (
+        set_current_vllm_config(vllm_config),
+        patch("vllm.platforms.current_platform", CpuPlatform()),
+    ):
+        backend = get_attn_backend(
+            128,
+            torch.bfloat16,
+            "auto",
+            attn_type=AttentionType.ENCODER_ONLY,
+        )
+    assert backend.get_name() == "CPU_ATTN"
+    assert backend.supports_attn_type(AttentionType.ENCODER_ONLY)
+
+
 @pytest.mark.skipif(
     not current_platform.is_cuda()
     or not current_platform.is_device_capability_family(100),

@@ -62,15 +62,12 @@ def __init__(
     ):
         dtype = torch.get_default_dtype()
 
-        if cache_config is not None:
-            kv_cache_dtype = cache_config.cache_dtype
-        else:
-            kv_cache_dtype = "auto"
-
+        # Encoder-only attention does not allocate a KV cache, so a global
+        # cache_dtype must not disqualify an otherwise valid backend.
         underlying_attn_backend = get_attn_backend(
             head_size,
             dtype,
-            kv_cache_dtype,
+            "auto",
             attn_type=AttentionType.ENCODER_ONLY,
         )
